paragraphs: When this report uses the words "the Company", "we", "us" and "our", these words refer to Monster Beverage Corporation and its subsidiaries, unless the context otherwise requires. Based in Corona, California, Monster Beverage Corporation is a holding company and conducts no operating business, except through its consolidated subsidiaries. The Company's subsidiaries primarily develop and market energy drinks.
We develop, market, sell and distribute energy drink beverages and concentrates for energy drink beverages, primarily under the following brand names:
● ​ ​ ​ ​Monster Energy® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Monster Energy Ultra® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Rehab Monster® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Monster Energy®Nitro
● ​ ​ ​ ​Java Monster® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Punch Monster® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Juice Monster® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Reign Total Body Fuel®
● ​ ​ ​ ​Reign Storm® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Bang Energy® ● ​ ​ ​ ​NOS® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Full Throttle® ​ ​ ​ ● ​ ​ ​ ​Burn®
● ​ ​ ​ ​Mother® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Nalu® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Ultra Energy® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Play® and Power Play® (stylized)
● ​ ​ ​ ​Relentless® ● ​ ​ ​ ​BPM® ● ​ ​ ​ ​BU® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Samurai® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Live+® ● ​ ​ ​ ​Predator®

We also develop, market, sell and distribute craft beers, flavored malt beverages ("FMBs") and hard seltzers under a number of brands, including Jai Alai® IPA, Florida Man® IPA, Dale's Pale Ale®, Wild Basin® Hard Seltzers, Dallas Blonde®, Deep EllumTM IPA, Perrin Brewing Company® Black Ale, Hop Rising® Double IPA, Wasatch® Apricot Hefeweizen, The BeastTM, Beast® Tea, Blind Lemon®, Blinder LemonTM and other brands.

The "alternative" beverage category combines non-carbonated, ready-to-drink iced teas, lemonades, juice cocktails, single-serve juices and fruit beverages, ready-to-drink dairy and coffee drinks, energy drinks, sports drinks and single-serve still waters (flavored, unflavored and enhanced) with "new age" beverages, including sodas that are considered natural, sparkling juices and flavored sparkling beverages. According to Beverage Marketing Corporation, domestic U.S. wholesale sales in 2025 for the "alternative" beverage category of the market are estimated at approximately $76.8 billion, representing an increase of approximately 2.4% over estimated domestic U.S. wholesale sales in 2024 of approximately $75.0 billion.

We have four operating and reportable segments: (i) Monster Energy® Drinks segment ("Monster Energy® Drinks"), which is primarily comprised of our Monster Energy® drinks, Reign Total Body Fuel® high performance energy drinks, Reign Storm® total wellness energy drinks and Bang Energy® drinks, (ii) Strategic Brands segment ("Strategic Brands"), which is primarily comprised of the various energy drink brands acquired from The Coca-Cola Company ("TCCC") in 2015 as well as our affordable energy brands, Predator® and Fury®, (iii) Alcohol Brands segment ("Alcohol Brands"), which is comprised of various craft beers, FMBs and hard seltzers and (iv) Other segment ("Other"), which is comprised of certain products sold by American Fruits and Flavors LLC ("AFF"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, to independent third-party customers (the "AFF Third-Party Products").

Our Monster Energy® Drinks segment primarily generates net operating revenues by selling ready-to-drink packaged drinks primarily to bottlers and full service beverage distributors ("bottlers/distributors"). In some cases, we sell ready-to-drink packaged drinks

directly to retail grocery and specialty chains, wholesalers, club stores, mass merchandisers, convenience and gas chains, drug stores, foodservice customers, value stores, e-commerce retailers and the military.

Our Strategic Brands segment primarily generates net operating revenues by selling "concentrates" and/or "beverage bases" to authorized bottling and canning operations. Such bottlers generally combine the concentrates and/or beverage bases with sweeteners, water and other ingredients to produce ready-to-drink packaged energy drinks. The ready-to-drink packaged energy drinks are then sold by such bottlers to other bottlers/distributors and to retail grocery and specialty chains, wholesalers, club stores, mass merchandisers, convenience and gas chains, foodservice customers, drug stores, value stores, e-commerce retailers and the military. To a lesser extent, our Strategic Brands segment generates net operating revenues by selling certain ready-to-drink packaged energy drinks to bottlers/distributors.
Generally, the Monster Energy® Drinks segment generates higher per case net operating revenues, but lower per case gross profit margin percentages than the Strategic Brands segment.

In addition to the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") and the consolidated financial statements and related notes, you should carefully consider the following risks. If any of the following risks actually occur or continue to occur, our business, reputation, financial condition and/or operating results could be materially adversely affected. The risk factors summarized below are not the only risks we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also materially adversely affect our business, reputation, financial condition and/or operating results.

The following is a summary of the principal risks that could materially adversely affect our business, reputation, financial condition and/or operating results. You should read this summary together with the more detailed description of each risk contained below.
● The Company and TCCC have extensive commercial arrangements and, as a result, the Company's future performance is substantially dependent on the success of its relationship with TCCC.
● Provisions in our organizational documents and control by insiders or TCCC may prevent changes in control even if such changes would be beneficial to other stockholders.

● We primarily rely on bottlers and other contract packers to manufacture our products. If we are unable to maintain good relationships with our bottlers and contract packers and/or their ability to manufacture our products becomes constrained or unavailable to us, our business could suffer.

● We rely on limited Company-owned facilities for production of certain of our non-alcohol and alcohol beverages, and developments negatively affecting production at such facilities could materially impact the financial results of our business.

paragraphs: 當本報告使用 "the Company"、"we"、"us" 和 "our" 這些詞語時，這些詞語指的是 Monster Beverage Corporation 及其子公司，除非上下文另有說明。本公司的總部設於加州科羅那，Monster Beverage Corporation 是一家控股公司，除透過其合併子公司進行營運外，本身不從事任何營業活動。本公司的子公司主要從事能量飲料的開發與市場行銷。
我們從事能量飲料飲品及能量飲料濃縮液的開發、市場行銷、銷售與分銷，主要以以下品牌名稱進行：

我們也從事精釀啤酒、調味麥芽飲料（"FMBs"）及氣泡水的開發、市場行銷、銷售與分銷，品牌包括 Jai Alai® IPA、Florida Man® IPA、Dale's Pale Ale®、Wild Basin® Hard Seltzers、Dallas Blonde®、Deep EllumTM IPA、Perrin Brewing Company® Black Ale、Hop Rising® Double IPA、Wasatch® Apricot Hefeweizen、The BeastTM、Beast® Tea、Blind Lemon®、Blinder LemonTM 及其他品牌。

「替代」飲料類別包含非氣泡、即飲冰茶、檸檬水、果汁雞尾酒、單次份量果汁與水果飲料、即飲乳製品與咖啡飲料、能量飲料、運動飲料與單次份量靜態水（有香氣、無香氣及增強型）與「新世代」飲料，包括被視為天然的汽水、氣泡果汁與有香氣氣泡飲料。根據 Beverage Marketing Corporation 的資料，2025 年美國國內零售業對「替代」飲料類別的預估銷售額約為 768 億美元，較 2024 年預估的 750 億美元增加約 2.4%。

我們有四個營運及應報告分部：(i) Monster Energy® 飲料分部（「Monster Energy® 飲料」），主要由我們的 Monster Energy® 飲料、Reign Total Body Fuel® 高性能能量飲料、Reign Storm® 全身健康能量飲料與 Bang Energy® 飲料組成；(ii) 戰略品牌分部（「戰略品牌」），主要由 2015 年自 The Coca-Cola Company（「TCCC」）取得的各類能量飲料品牌以及我們的經濟型能量飲料品牌 Predator® 與 Fury® 組成；(iii) 酒精品牌分部（「酒精品牌」），包含各類手工啤酒、FMBs 與氣泡酒精飲料；(iv) 其他分部（「其他」），包含由本公司全資子公司 American Fruits and Flavors LLC（「AFF」）銷售給獨立第三方客戶的某些產品（「AFF 第三方產品」）。
我們的 Monster Energy® 飲料分部主要透過銷售即飲包裝飲料產生淨營運收入，主要銷售對象為灌裝商與全服務飲料經銷商（「灌裝商/經銷商」）。在某些情況下，我們也會直接銷售即飲包裝飲料
給零售超市與專業連鎖店、經銷商、俱樂部商店、大規模零售商、便利商店與加油站連鎖店、藥妝店、餐飲客戶、折扣商店、電商零售商與軍隊。

我們的戰略品牌分部主要透過銷售「濃縮液」與/或「飲料基底」產生淨營運收入，至經授權的灌裝與罐裝操作。這些灌裝商通常會將濃縮液與/或飲料基底與甜味劑、水及其他成分混合，製成即飲包裝能量飲料。這些即飲包裝能量飲料隨後由灌裝商銷售給其他灌裝商/經銷商，以及零售超市與專業連鎖店、經銷商、俱樂部商店、大規模零售商、便利商店與加油站連鎖店、餐飲客戶、藥妝店、折扣商店、電商零售商與軍隊。在較小程度上，我們的戰略品牌分部也會透過銷售某些即飲包裝能量飲料給灌裝商/經銷商產生淨營運收入。
通常，Monster Energy® 飲料分部每箱的淨營運收入較高，但每箱的毛利率百分比較戰略品牌分部低。

paragraphs: 以下之管理討論與分析（MD&A）為財務報表及附屬附註（"附註"）之補充資料，應與本Form 10-K第二部分，第8項所載財務報表及附屬附註一併閱讀。本討論包含基於管理階層目前預期、估計及預測之展望性陳述。本公司實際結果可能與該等展望性陳述所表達之預期有重大差異。請參閱"展望性陳述"及"第一部分，第1A項–風險因素"。
此總覽提供本公司對MD&A各個部分之觀點。MD&A包含以下部分：
● 價格調節措施 – 討論2025年及2024年所實施之特定價格調節措施；
● 本公司業務 – 本公司業務之總體描述、業務價值驅動因素，以及本公司所面臨之機會與風險、股票買回、收購與出售；
● 業務經營成果 – 分析本公司2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日財年整體經營成果；
● 売出情形 – 本公司每季以美元及件數為單位之銷售細節；
● 通貨膨脹 – 有關通貨膨脹可能或可能不會對本公司結果產生影響之資訊；
● 流動性及資本資源 – 分析本公司現金流量、現金來源與使用及契約義務；
● 會計政策與會計準則 – 討論需要關鍵判斷與估計的會計政策，包括新頒布的會計準則；
● 未來展望陳述 – 警示未來展望陳述的資訊，並說明某些可能導致實際結果與本公司歷史結果或目前預期或預測有重大差異的風險與不確定性；
● 市場風險 – 有關市場風險與風險管理的資訊。(參見 "未來展望陳述" 以及 "第二部分，第7A項 – 有關市場風險的質性與量化揭露")
我們在財務年度2025與2024的第四季於美國對核心品牌與包裝實施了價格調漲，並在2025與2024年於某些國際市場於不同時間點實施價格調漲（合稱為 "價格調漲措施"）。價格調漲措施在2025年對毛利率產生正面影響，相較於2024年。
截至本申報文件之日，我們預期將維持足夠的流動性，如 "流動性與資本資源" 節所述。

下列為可能對本公司之業務、聲譽、財務狀況及/或營運成果造成重大不利影響之主要風險總結。您應配合下列更詳細說明每項風險之內容一同閱讀此總結。
● 本公司與 TCCC 有廣泛之商業安排，因此本公司未來之表現大幅取決於其與 TCCC 關係之成功。
● 我們組織章程中之條款及由內部人士或 TCCC 所控制，可能防止控制權之變更，即使此變更對其他股東而言為有益。
● 我們主要依賴灌裝商及其他契約包裝商製造我們之產品。若我們無法維持與灌裝商及契約包裝商之良好關係，或其製造我們產品之能力受到限制或無法提供，將可能對我們之業務造成影響。
● 我們依賴有限之本公司自有設施製造部分非酒精及酒精飲料，若這些設施之生產發生負面發展，將可能對我們之財務成果造成重大影響。
